description: Phase 1C investigation questions remain valid under schema 1.1.0. Q-MCP-* are not listed yet (no SPL in Phase 3B). Splunk is corroborating unless run completeness is established. Do not hunt names that are not listed.

correlation_keys.note: First lab: incident.id equals run.id on every event.

questions.question: WHICH event contract produced this record?
WHICH prior hop influenced this hop?
questions.note: Required when hop.index >= 1. Absent on hop 0. In-process attribution, not A2A.

questions.question: HOW do hops nest under the pipeline?
WHAT did the reference control decide, and WHY?
WAS inference prevented before invocation?
questions.proof: Authoritative: runtime did not invoke the LLM. Local complete events.jsonl: DENY or pre-invoke ERROR, attempted=false, executed=false, outcome=prevented, and no llm.* for that hop. Splunk with no llm.* is corroborating only unless completeness for that run.id is established (export ok and expected event set present).
questions.not_proof: Absence of llm.* in Splunk alone.

questions.question: DID ALLOW actually start inference, and how did that call end?
questions.proof: ALLOW on control.decision is not execution. llm.started: attempted=true, executed=true. llm.completed: outcome=success. llm.failed: executed=true, outcome=error (started, then failed — not prevention).
questions.not_proof: ALLOW alone; missing llm.* in Splunk after ALLOW (may be export loss).

questions.question: WHAT was the actual pipeline outcome?
questions.note: agentsec.outcome is hop/run. agentsec.operation.outcome is the governed LLM result (prevented|success|error).

questions.question: WHICH experiment, and how did it run?
questions.note: Filter baseline vs attack vs retest with testbed.mode (BASELINE|ATTACK|RETEST), not execution.mode. First lab: execution.mode=LIVE, telemetry.fidelity=OBSERVED.

questions.question: WHAT content influenced the hop, without full prompts?
questions.note: Default store is preview + hash. Complete prompts are not required for evidence.
